# LivePreview (AI Code Tester)

**LivePreview** is a "Paste & View" tool designed to instantly test HTML/CSS/JS code generated by AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini) without the hassle of creating local files.

> **⚡ Vibe Coded** – Built in pure flow with AI assistance.

![LivePreview Screenshot](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400?text=LivePreview+Screenshot)

## 🚀 Features

*   **Code-First Editor:** Monaco Editor (VS Code experience) with HTML syntax highlighting.
*   **Live Preview:** Safe, isolated real-time preview (Auto-reload with debounce).
*   **RWD Tester:** Desktop / Mobile toggle switch and a Zoom slider to simulate high-res screens on smaller devices.
*   **Smart Paste:** Automatically wraps raw `<body>` or CSS content in a standard HTML5 boilerplate.
*   **Download:** Export your work as a ready-to-use `index.html` file with one click.
*   **Dark Mode:** Modern, dark-themed UI powered by Tailwind CSS v4.

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

*   **Frontend:** React 19 + Vite 7
*   **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 (with `@tailwindcss/postcss`)
*   **Editor:** `@monaco-editor/react`
*   **Layout:** `react-resizable-panels`

## 📦 How to run locally?

1.  Clone the repository.
2.  Install dependencies:
    ```bash
    npm install
    ```
3.  Start the development server:
    ```bash
    npm run dev
    ```
4.  Open `http://localhost:5173` in your browser.

## 🚢 Build & Deploy (Coolify/Vercel)

This is a static SPA. To build for production:

```bash
npm run build
```

The production-ready files will be generated in the `dist/` directory.
